headline: Ostlund beats Clayton 5-4 on Grand Slam debut after match-dart miss
standfirst: Anton Ostlund took the opening upset of the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton, winning a final-leg decider with a 97 finish against Jonny Clayton.
body: Anton Ostlund made a winning start on his Grand Slam of Darts debut, edging Jonny Clayton 5-4 in Group G at Aldersley Leisure Village in Wolverhampton on Saturday afternoon.

The Swede made the better start and moved 2-0 in front. Clayton, one of the seeded players in the field, then found his rhythm and appeared to be heading for a comfortable win as the match swung his way.
It did not finish that way. Clayton missed match darts in the deciding leg, and Ostlund punished him by taking out 97 to claim the points.

The result gave the new 48-player format an early shake-up. Each group is played as a round-robin among three players and only the winner is guaranteed to progress, so a defeat in the opening game leaves little room for error.

The same session produced several other notable results. Nathan Aspinall beat Maik Kuivenhoven 5-1 in Group P with an average of 111.68, having been above 116 for much of the match, while Tommy Morris saw off Josh Rock 5-2 in Group C. Tom Sykes, also a debutant, came from 3-2 down to beat Luke Woodhouse 5-3.
Ostlund opened Group G with a win, while Clayton was left needing to recover in the rest of the group. Luke Littler against Beau Greaves headlined the evening session on the opening day.
